1. congestion (n)
/kənˈdʒestʃən/
sự ùn tắc giao thông, nạn kẹt xe
Collocation: severe traffic congestion, reduce road congestion
"Expanding the underground metro is the best way to reduce severe traffic congestion."
2. commute (v/n)
/kəˈmjuːt/
đi lại hằng ngày giữa nhà và nơi làm việc/học tập
Collocation: commute to work, daily morning commute
"Thousands of suburban residents commute to the city centre by train every morning."
3. passenger (n)
/ˈpæsɪndʒə(r)/
hành khách (đi tàu, xe buýt, máy bay)
Collocation: rail passenger, passenger safety
"Electric buses can carry up to eighty passengers comfortably and quietly."
4. vehicle (n)
/ˈviːəkl/
phương tiện giao thông, xe cộ
Collocation: private vehicle, electric vehicle (EV)
"Banning private vehicles from narrow historic streets helps improve air quality."
5. infrastructure (n)
/ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə(r)/
cơ sở hạ tầng (cầu đường, bến bãi, mạng lưới điện/giao thông)
Collocation: transport infrastructure, upgrade infrastructure
"The government is investing billions of dollars in modern transport infrastructure."
6. railway (n)
/ˈreɪlweɪ/
đường sắt, hệ thống tàu hỏa
Collocation: high-speed railway, national railway network
"A new high-speed railway now links the capital with major coastal ports."
7. reliable (adj)
/rɪˈlaɪəbl/
đáng tin cậy, hoạt động ổn định
Collocation: reliable public transport, safe and reliable
"People will drive less if the city provides a cheap and reliable bus service."
8. punctual (adj)
/ˈpʌŋktʃuəl/
đúng giờ (không bị trễ chuyến)
Collocation: punctual train service, always punctual
"Japanese bullet trains are world-famous for being extremely punctual."
9. cyclist (n)
/ˈsaɪklɪst/
người đi xe đạp
Collocation: dedicated lane for cyclists, protect cyclists
"Building separate bike lanes protects cyclists from heavy trucks and cars."
10. delay (n/v)
/dɪˈleɪ/
sự chậm trễ, sự trì hoãn chuyến đi
Collocation: long traffic delay, cause a two-hour delay
"Heavy snow caused a two-hour delay on the morning commuter railway line."
11. subsidize (v)
/ˈsʌbsɪdaɪz/
trợ giá, hỗ trợ kinh phí từ ngân sách nhà nước
Collocation: subsidize bus fares, heavily subsidized
"Local authorities should subsidize public transit so low-income workers can afford it."
12. convenient (adj)
/kənˈviːniənt/
thuận tiện, tiện lợi
Collocation: fast and convenient, convenient location
"Paying for metro tickets with a smartphone app is fast and convenient."
13. alternative (n/adj)
/ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/
giải pháp thay thế, phương án lựa chọn khác
Collocation: eco-friendly alternative, alternative transport
"Cycling is a healthy and eco-friendly alternative to driving a private car."
14. exhaust (n)
/ɪɡˈzɔːst/
khí thải độc hại từ ống xả động cơ xe
Collocation: toxic exhaust fumes, car exhaust
"Breathing toxic exhaust fumes from diesel trucks can damage human lungs."
15. network (n)
/ˈnetwɜːk/
mạng lưới (tuyến xe buýt, tàu điện, đường bộ)
Collocation: underground metro network, extensive road network
"London has an extensive underground metro network that serves millions daily."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Phân Biệt Because/Since + Mệnh Đề vs. Because of/Due to + Cụm Danh Từ)

• Nhóm đi với Mệnh đề (S + V): because / since / as + S + V
  Ví dụ: Many commuters prefer the metro because it is punctual and convenient.

• Nhóm đi với Cụm danh từ hoặc V-ing: because of / due to / owing to + Noun Phrase / V-ing
  Ví dụ: Flights were cancelled due to severe weather delays (không có động từ chia thì sau due to).

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Từ Nối Chỉ Hệ Quả Học Thuật: Therefore, Consequently, As a result)

• Công thức nối 2 câu độc lập (hoặc sau dấu chấm phẩy):
  Mệnh đề nguyên nhân. Therefore, / Consequently, / As a result, + Mệnh đề kết quả.
  Ví dụ: Too many people drive private vehicles during rush hour. Consequently, city centres suffer from severe traffic congestion and toxic exhaust fumes.

• Động từ chỉ nguyên nhân - kết quả trực tiếp (Band 7.0+): lead to / result in / cause + Noun Phrase
  Ví dụ: Investing in railway infrastructure leads to faster daily commutes.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. During rush hour, thousands of cars enter the city centre and cause severe traffic ________.
2. Instead of driving, my father takes the underground train to ________ to his office every day.
3. The government should ________ bus and train fares so that students and workers pay less.
4. High-speed trains are a clean and fast ________ to short domestic flights.
5. Old petrol cars release toxic ________ fumes that pollute the air in crowded streets.
6. A modern city needs strong transport ________, including bridges, tunnels, and metro lines.
7. Every ________ on the express bus must wear a seatbelt for safety.
8. The city has painted green bike lanes along the river to keep ________ safe from heavy traffic.
9. Swiss trains are famous for being extremely ________; they almost never arrive late.
10. Because the metro station is right next to my flat, taking the train is very ________.
11. An accident on the highway caused a forty-minute ________ for morning commuters.
12. Electric ________ produce zero tailpipe emissions and are much quieter than diesel trucks.
13. Citizens will only give up their cars if the public bus system is frequent and ________.
14. Engineers are building a high-speed ________ that connects the airport with the city centre.
15. Expanding the underground metro ________ will allow millions of people to travel easily.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 7] The central shopping street has been turned into a car-free ________ zone.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 7] The old bus depot was ________ to make way for a modern railway station.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 6] In a modern ________ family, both parents often commute to work every day.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 5] Commuters can buy digital train tickets on a smartphone ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 3] Switching from petrol cars to electric trains helps cut carbon ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Morning trains were delayed for thirty minutes ________ heavy fog on the railway tracks.
2. Many office workers prefer taking the metro ________ it is punctual and avoids road congestion.
3. The city council heavily subsidized bus fares. ________, the number of bus passengers increased by 40%.
4. Severe traffic congestion ________ a lack of reliable public transport in rapidly growing cities.
5. Breathing toxic exhaust fumes every day can ________ serious respiratory illnesses.
6. ________ the high cost of city-centre parking, most commuters now leave their private vehicles at home.
7. Dedicated bike lanes are very safe. ________, more students are cycling to university.
8. ________ the new express railway opened last month, daily commuting time has dropped by half.
9. Poor road infrastructure ________ long traffic delays during the rainy season.
10. Electric buses are quiet and clean; ________, they are an ideal alternative for modern cities.
Điểm: 0/10

👩 Transit Clerk: Good morning, Metro Customer Service! How can I help you with your travel pass today?
👨 Commuter: Hello! I just moved to the northern suburb, and I need a reliable way to commute to the city centre.
👩 Transit Clerk: You should definitely apply for our Monthly Smart Commuter Card. It covers both the railway and electric buses.
👨 Commuter: That sounds very convenient! How long does the express train take from North Station to Central Plaza?
👩 Transit Clerk: Driving a car takes nearly an hour due to congestion, but the express train takes only 22 minutes. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: 22 / 22 minutes
👨 Commuter: Wow, 22 minutes is super fast! What if I want to bring my bicycle to the station?
👩 Transit Clerk: We have a free secure parking area for cyclists right next to Platform 1. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: Platform 1
👨 Commuter: How much does the Monthly Smart Commuter Card cost for full-time workers?
👩 Transit Clerk: The normal price is 90 pounds, but because the city council subsidizes green travel, it is now 65 pounds. 💡 Bẫy giá cũ vs giá đã trợ giá câu 3: 65
👨 Commuter: Great! Can I also use the card on the weekend airport shuttle?
👩 Transit Clerk: Yes, all cardholders get free rides on the Green Express bus network on Saturdays and Sundays. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: Green Express
👨 Commuter: Let's register! My surname is Henderson. That is spelled H - E - N - D - E - R - S - O - N. 💡 Đáp án đánh vần câu 5: HENDERSON
👩 Transit Clerk: Thank you, Mr. Henderson. What document do you have to verify your home address?
👨 Commuter: I brought my electricity bill and my driving licence. 💡 Đáp án câu 6: driving licence / electricity bill
👩 Transit Clerk: Perfect! Here is your new Smart Commuter Card. Have a punctual and pleasant journey!

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The High Cost of Private Vehicles]
In many rapidly growing cities, millions of residents rely on private vehicles for their daily commute. Due to the overwhelming number of cars on narrow roads, city centres suffer from severe traffic congestion and long delays. Not only does this waste valuable working hours, but toxic exhaust fumes from petrol engines also damage public health and the urban environment.

[Paragraph B - Building a Reliable Transit Network]
Urban planners agree that the most effective solution is to upgrade public transport infrastructure. When a city expands its underground metro and high-speed railway network, thousands of passengers can travel simultaneously without roadblocks. Because modern electric trains are punctual, safe, and convenient, commuters willingly leave their cars at home.

[Paragraph C - Subsidies and Green Alternatives]
Furthermore, governments should subsidize ticket prices so that public transit remains affordable for every citizen. Cities can also create dedicated lanes for cyclists and electric buses, offering an eco-friendly alternative for short trips. Consequently, investing in a reliable public transit system reduces pollution and makes urban life far more enjoyable.
Điểm: 0/6
